principles: Keep the implicit skill surface small: one entry skill per factory, with progressive disclosure into references.
Specialized factories may invoke Phase 2 roles, but they do not hard-code MCP servers or replace project-native tools.
General Factory is a fallback selected by the global router and therefore disables implicit invocation to avoid shadowing specialized skills.
Software and CAD/3DP factories preserve a single-writer integration boundary for overlapping edits.
Astra is a scarce reasoning specialist, not a bulk worker.
